terminal_receipt.explanation: The two-job execution is faulty because downstream priority ordering cannot preserve upstream provenance order: every observed priority has upstream_rank 0. The supplied upstream source shows assemble_provenance builds evidence_sources with record_id set to source_id (for example s01) instead of preserving the demand record_id (for example n06-r01). Job 2 then receives evidence_sources keyed by s01..s08 while coverage rows are keyed by n06-r01..n06-r08, so prioritize cannot match ranks to needs. The supported localization is therefore the upstream assemble_provenance function, not the downstream ranking function.
